name: Maha Shatpala Ghrita

sections.overview: Maha Shatpala Ghrita – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Maha Shatpala Ghrita is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to be prepared from the mixture of many herbs. This helps to treat problems related with digestion and kapha related diseases.
sections.ingredients:
Ghrita (ghee) 
 Buttermilk 
 Yavakshara (Hordeum vulgare) 
 Pippalimoola (Piper longum’s root) 
 Chitraka (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Chavya (Piper chaba) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Shunti (Zingiber officinale) 

 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the ingredients and mix with ghrita (clarified butter) in a container. Cook till the herbal ghee is prepared.
sections.dose:
15 to 30 ml 
 Indication 

 Bloating due to kapha 
 Dyspepsia 
 Indigestion 
 Chronic fever
sections.contraindications:
Take the formulation under doctor’s prescription. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Maha Shatpala Ghrita – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Siddha Yoga sangraha, Ghritaprakarana 
 Introduction 
 Maha Shatpala Ghrita is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to be prepared from the mixture of many herbs. This helps to treat problems related with digestion and kapha related diseases. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ghrita (ghee) 
 Buttermilk 
 Yavakshara (Hordeum vulgare) 
 Pippalimoola (Piper longum’s root) 
 Chitraka (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Chavya (Piper chaba) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Shunti (Zingiber officinale) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the ingredients and mix with ghrita (clarified butter) in a container. Cook till the herbal ghee is prepared. 
 Dose 
 15 to 30 ml 
 Indication 
 
 Bloating due to kapha 
 Dyspepsia 
 Indigestion 
 Chronic fever 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the formulation under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
